{{External|rs|rsc=Bronze Chain Mail Body}} {{Infobox Item |name = Bronze chainbody |image = [[File:Bronze chainbody.png]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wear, Drop |examine = A series of connected metal rings. |value = 60 |weight = 6.803 |respawn = 700 |exchange = Yes |id = 1103 }} [[File:Bronze chainbody detail.png|120px|left]] The '''bronze chainbody''' is a chainbody that can be made at an anvil with 3 [[bronze bar]]s and a hammer with a [[Smithing]] level of 11, granting 37.5 Smithing experience. Since it requires a [[Defence]] level of 1 to wear, it can be worn by any player. It is one of the weakest armour chest pieces in the game and is seldom worn. The bronze chainbody can be obtained through a spawn located in the [[Dwarven Mine]]. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = -15 |arange = 0 |dstab = +7 |dslash = +11 |dcrush = +13 |dmagic = -3 |drange = +9 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = body |image = [[File:Bronze chainbody equipped male.png]] |altimage = [[File:Bronze chainbody equipped female.png|150px]] }} ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Smithing |skill1lvl = 11 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 37.5 |members = No |ticks = 5 |tools = Hammer |facilities = Anvil |mat1 = Bronze bar |mat1quantity = 3 |output1 = Bronze chainbody }} ==Treasure Trails== {{EmoteClue}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Bronze chainbody}} ===Spawns=== {{ItemSpawnTableHead}} {{ItemSpawnLine|name=Bronze chainbody|location=[[Dwarven Mines]] -
